earlier_scan.source_named: Winarno, Frans; Susilo, Firman; Simanjuntak, Hotma. 2013. Fonologi bahasa Dayak Menterap Kabut (18pp phonology; Glottolog ref 552188). No open copy found

sources.citation: Winarno, Frans; Susilo, Firman; Simanjuntak, Hotma. 2013. Fonologi bahasa Dayak Menterap Kabut. Jurnal Pendidikan dan Pembelajaran Khatulistiwa (JPPK) 2(5): 1-18. DOI 10.26418/jppk.v2i5.2026. (Glottolog ref 552188, listed by Glottolog as a phonology)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The whole 18-page article (Fonetik: vowels/consonants/diphthongs/sequences; Fonemik: phonemes and allophones; Struktur Suku Kata; Simpulan) has zero occurrences of tekanan, aksen, stress, suprasegmental, intonasi, nada or prosodi; the only prosodic-looking remark is vowel length ('bunyi panjang' [i:], [o:], [a:]; /a:/ phonemic). Syllable structure is stated as VK, KV, KVK, words mostly di- and trisyllabic. Data from Landau Kumpai (Nanga Mahap, Sekadau), two informants.
